protocol.timing: run_once(False) synchronized forward wall; no per-group probes, constructor/cache creation outside timed forward
protocol.aggregation: median of three window medians; uniform control within-window is median(before,after) block medians
protocol.drift_policy: Keep every sample/window in primary results; flag >10% before-after anchor drift; no rerun-to-pass or deletion. Repeat-consistent evidence requires all windows pass drift.
protocol.failure_policy: Persist failed slot and abort; never exclude failed candidate or overwrite its slot. Incomplete runs have no regret conclusion.
protocol.lifecycle: Rebuild executor each block; reuse canonical CPU templates within a task; no empty_cache between blocks
protocol.resume: Skip already recorded slots on identical environment; a window spanning collection processes is flagged and cannot establish repeat-consistent evidence.
protocol.selection: A2 members only: both uniform directions; local QKV100/110/111 and gate-up01/10/11 on first/last layers; all whole-layer boundaries; expand both physical directions
protocol.scope: Development plan-competition diagnosis, not independent SROP benefit or training throughput. No new kernel profiling/refit/re-search.
